_doc: Pixel mapping of the orthographic views in ref/<id>_blueprint.jpg for lib/compare_blueprint.py: per view [bx0, sx, by0, sz, wx0, zc]: blueprint px of the world reference wx0 (side/top: front bumper tip at -length/2, front/rear: centre line), px per metre along the view, blueprint px of the ground (top view: centre line), px per metre vertical (top: lateral), world value at bx0, vertical centre of the render. Measured on the sheets with ruler crops; AI sheets are not exactly to scale, so the vertical and lateral scales are fitted to the real height and width (ref/dimensions.json).
